entries.title: Enemies Fight Back
notes: Armed enemies now shoot, throw, swing and rocket on their own - they aim, lead their shots and back off when crowded
Knockback on every weapon, death animations, and an animation speed control per actor
Switches, gates and keys - doors and chests can need a key, and switches on a channel drive gates for multi-step puzzles
Boost pads, custom crosshairs, grip offsets, mirrored drawing in Textures, and Face Paint
BLOOM3D parts unlock - buy once, keep forever, every pack plus everything added later
Big fights hold a steady frame rate now, and rocket and grenade kills no longer hitch
Fixed: RESET and RANDOMIZE could overwrite a saved character. They no longer touch your saved players.

entries.title: BLOOM3D and a New Color Picker
notes: BLOOM3D is live as its own tab - build in 3D right in the browser, nothing to install
New color picker across the whole 3D editor - mix a color once and reuse it anywhere
Your recent colors are saved and follow you between projects
Textures rebuilt around one palette instead of scattered swatch grids

entries.title: Jump Pads and a Tier Gate Fix
notes: Game maker engine 2.9.1 to 2.9.6
New: jump pads. Drop one in a side-scrolling room and it launches the hero at the angle, power and hang time you set - straight up, or off at an angle across a gap
Fonts now ship with Spiralside itself instead of loading from Google, so the game maker looks right on a slow connection
Exported games carry their own fonts too - still one HTML file, nothing to fetch
Fixed: paid users were being shown free demo limits. If you bought the game maker and could not add a fourth room, that was this. Your rooms were never touched.

entries.title: Weapons, Bosses, Endings and Collision You Can Author
notes: Game maker engine 2.3.0 to 2.9.1 across dozens of builds
Every weapon now has four sprite slots - the weapon in hand, the swing or muzzle flash, the bullet, and the impact puff - drawn in the Sprite tool and assigned per weapon
Damage and knockback sliders on every weapon card, saved with the project - knockback shoves foes back and stuns them, and bosses stand firm
Each of those four weapon parts gets its own sound: the equip click, the shot, the bullet, the hit
SFX Designer can build gunshots now - 16 presets from pistol to plasma to explosion, plus noise mix, drive, sub boom, attack, tone, and up to 8 repeats for bursts
The SFX bank doubled from 16 slots to 32
Dialogue windows are fully yours: a live preview at real game size while you edit, and a new Panel tab for fill, tiled patterns, frame, corner rounding, width, padding, placement, glow and opacity
Speaker name and text each keep their own font, color, size, outline, glow and alignment
Bomb walls, boulders, conveyors, doors and kill tiles can span several cells now - one key opens a whole wide door, one bomb clears a whole slab
Fixed: Inspector arrows and minimise buttons no longer overlap nearby controls
Fixed: Align now actually moves the speaker name and text in the dialogue box
Fixed: panel patterns render instead of silently failing
Fixed: a weapon sound pointing at an erased bank slot falls back instead of going silent
Bosses can talk: write an INTRO line, a line for each phase change, and an OUTRO for the killing blow, all with the same editor and styling as any other dialogue
Leave a boss line empty and that beat stays silent, so nothing in an existing game changes
Build your own ending: Map > WORLD > SCENE now makes full ending pages with title, text and images, and the Win action picks which ending plays
Bosses appear in the ACTORS roster with their own preview card and stat readout, alongside player, pet, enemies and NPCs
Inspector move and minimise buttons now work on nested sections like QUICK ENEMY, MOVEMENT and BRAIN, not just top-level ones
Touch control pads got a look pass
Hero collision shape is yours now: pick auto, box, round or slim per sprite under Sprite > HIT MASK
Fixed: the hero no longer sticks when walking up slopes - ramps now give a proper step-up, and walking downhill glues you to the surface instead of hopping
Every tile can override its own collision - auto, none, solid or one-way - under Tiles > COLLISION
One-way ledges: jump up through them, land on top, walk out sideways from underneath
Stamped sprites can block or not block, or act as one-way ledges, under Sprite > STAMP BLOCKS - build jump-through platforms out of art without spending a terrain slot
Moving platforms can be solid slabs or jump-through, set per slab under Map > Platform
Import an image straight into a sprite frame or a tile - it scales, quantizes and adds new colours to your palette automatically
Duplicate a sprite in one click, and nudge sprite or tile art in any direction with wrap-around, so tiles line up seamlessly
Tile variants: up to 4 art versions per tile, scattered consistently across a room so ground stops looking like wallpaper
Send feedback straight from inside the app - it goes to the team, no email client needed, and your text is never lost if the send fails
Quest system and dialogue styling from earlier builds are now fully in

entries.title: Cloud Saves + a Bigger Editor
notes: Never lose a project: all 10 save slots now back up to the cloud, not just the one you are in - a browser wipe can no longer take your work
Import a project straight from the Project card, right next to Export
Game maker engine 2.2.0 to 2.3.0 across dozens of builds
Push blocks and push-stops now work in top-down rooms, and blocks ride conveyor belts in every mode
New Block Reset switch: step on it in play and every push block snaps home, so puzzle rooms are replayable
Per-sprite animation speed (half to 3x) on the new x-chip in the FRAMES row
Heroes auto-generate 5 pose variants - walk, side, jump, hurt, morph - and switch between them in play
Room background randomizer: hue, vivid, light and grain sliders plus 5 patterns, saved per room
Gates and switches now come in 4 color channels for layered lock puzzles
Paintable fog-of-war that reveals permanently as the player explores
Ramp tiles the hero slides along, two decor layers, and decor on FPS walls, floors and ceilings
World map view with drag-to-arrange rooms, per-room music and SFX, scene transitions and story pages
Timers with HUD chips and logic actions, a song and SFX bank, and an FX rack (echo, distortion, phaser)
Paint custom skins on any entity, custom weapon sprites, and a co-op sidekick pet on a second gamepad
Account data locked down tighter behind the scenes

entries.title: Engine 2.2.0 + Account Sprint
notes: Game maker: engine 2.1.0 to 2.2.0, 30+ builds of fixes and features
Game maker: BloomQuest sample project baked in so there is something to play with
Forgot your password? Reset link now works, straight from the sign in screen
Fixed: intro screen could block sign in on some browsers. Gone.
Sidebar collapses now, more room for the work
Mobile: layout and keyboard fixes throughout
Skyline ticker on the home screen

entries.title: Game Maker Engine 2.1.0
notes: Game maker updated: BloomDesktop engine 2.0.3 to 2.1.0
Engine version now tracked internally for cleaner updates

entries.title: Makeover Day
notes: Desktop redesign: sidebar navigation, fullscreen layout
New tab: game maker - build games right inside Spiralside
Split screen: drag the divider to resize, double-click to reset
Header buttons: hide/show tabs, split screen
New minimal startup screen - straight into the app
Chat: comfortable reading width on big monitors
Tip: drag tabs in the sidebar to reorder them - it saves
